# smc_protocol (Resource)

This represents a Protocol Agent. It is a process on the engines that assists the engine in handling a particular Protocol. Protocol Agents ensure that related connections for a service are properly grouped and evaluated by the engine, as well as assisting the engine with content filtering or network address translation tasks.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `comment` (String) An optional comment for the element. This field is not required.
- `deep_inspection_registration_number` (Number) Internal use: it generates specific registration number when deep inspection is used. This concerns only for fw version <= 5.2.x.
- `fallback_agent_id` (Number) Internal use: Id of the agent that should be used as a fallback.
- `id` (String) this attribute is the identifier of terraform resource
- `identifier_situation` (Number) Internal use: Id of the situation (application) which can be used for identifying this protocol.
- `link_selection` (Block, Optional) This represents the link selection value used in QoS settings, defining various network parameters such as bandwidth, jitter, latency, packet loss, and stability. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--link_selection))
- `module_build` (String) Dummy module info: build of the sensor module.
- `module_max_version` (String) Dummy module info: Max Version (concatenation between ips and fw max version).
- `module_min_version` (String) Dummy module info: Min Version (concatenation between ips and fw min version).
- `module_name` (String) Dummy module info: name of the sensor module *.so binary file name.
- `module_upload_always` (Boolean) Dummy module info: upload always flag of the sensor module.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.
- `override_module_id` (Number) Overrides the registration number or system key as the module id, if set. Used for inspection module and sidewinder proxy stacked services.
- `pa_parameters` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_parameters))
- `pa_values` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_values))
- `protocol_matching_in_inspection` (Boolean) Flag to know if a protocol can be used in inspection policy, for column Protocol. Default value = true
- `registration_number` (Number) Internal use: used by the firewall to reference a protocol agent.
- `supported_protocol` (List of String) List of supported protocols: ethernet, ip-proto, tcp, udp, icmp, physical.
- `type` (String) The Protocol Agent type.

<a id="nestedblock--pa_values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pa_values`

Optional:

- `boolean_value` (Block, Optional) This represents the Protocol Agent Boolean parameter value, which can be either '0' for false or '1' for true. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_values--boolean_value))

(see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_values--checkbox_list_value))

- `integer_value` (Block, Optional) This represents the Protocol Agent Integer parameter value, which can be used to configure various integer-based parameters in the Protocol Agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_values--integer_value))

- `macro_value` (Block, Optional) This represents the Protocol Agent Macro parameter value, which can be either '1' for $CLUSTER_IPS or '0' for $NODE_IP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_values--macro_value))
- `ordered_list_box_value` (Block, Optional) This represents the Protocol Agent Ordered List Box parameter value, which is a string of selected ordered list box rows in the format 'X,Y,...' where X, Y are the indices of the selected rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_values--ordered_list_box_value))
- `pa_dns_sinkhole_list` (Block, Optional) This represents the Protocol Agent DNS Sinkhole List parameter value, which contains a list of DNS Sinkhole rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_values--pa_dns_sinkhole_list))
- `pa_urlmatchlist` (Block, Optional) This represents the Protocol Agent URL Match List parameter value, which contains a list of URL match rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_values--pa_urlmatchlist))
- `proxy_service_value` (Block, Optional) This represents the Protocol Agent Proxy service parameter value, which is used to configure proxy services in the Protocol Agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_values--proxy_service_value))
- `ssh_profile_value` (Block, Optional) This represents the Protocol Agent SSH Profile parameter value, which is used to reference an SSH profile in the Protocol Agent configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_values--ssh_profile_value))
- `string_value` (Block, Optional) This represents the Protocol Agent String parameter value, which can be used to configure string-based parameters in the Protocol Agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_values--string_value))
- `tls_inspection_policy_value` (Block, Optional) This represents the Protocol Agent TLS Inspection policy parameter value, which is used to reference a specific TLS Inspection Policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pa_values--tls_inspection_policy_value))
